title: Mo Longzi falls
summary: With Shen Cangsheng, Li Xuantong and Luo Li wounded, Mu Chen lets the Great Sumeru Demonic Pillar's power take him over again, the same demonic look he had on the White Dragon mission, while the others buy him time. He brushes off the Three Generals and Mo Longzi's Dragon-transforming Blood Art and beats Mo Longzi, who uses the Dragon Demon Divine Art and still loses, as payback for hurting Luo Li. When Mu Chen moves to finish him, the Black Dragon Sovereign strikes to take back the Pillar, and Dean Tai Cang steps in to protect the students, calling it a fight of the younger generation. The Black Dragon Sovereign warns that the Dragon Demon Palace will take Mu Chen's life and North Heaven will be destroyed. At the Holy Spiritual Academy, Ji Xuan's elder teaches him that the strong must be cold-blooded, and Ji Xuan takes charge of the collaboration between Master Wuliang and the Dragon Demon Palace.
events: Mu Chen's allies hold the line while he prepares his trump card
